headline: Prioritize playback reliability: stop failures, false connection errors, and crashes
memo_markdown:
## Recommendation
Make playback reliability the next-quarter priority. Fix `playback.playback_stops_or_skips`, then investigate `playback.connection_error` and `playback.crash_freeze`.

## Evidence
Playback accounts for 40 complaints [A015], with mean severity 3.350000 [A017]; 17 were severity four or higher [A020], representing 42.5% of playback complaints [A021]. Stops or failures to start had 17 complaints [C013] and a severity sum of 59 [C014]. Playback’s share rose from 3.88% in the early trend window [T033] to 9.25% in the late window [T036]. Representative reports: a7b7539a-c8d3-4f4e-9edd-d46cd1b1fd12, f87fb3d9-501a-4119-bc40-b0669270ae44, and 4a806587-0dde-4fb4-b4f1-f5c7d197c927.

## Alternatives considered
Billing/support has more complaints, 50 [A008], but lower mean severity, 3.020000 [A010]; its trend share rose from 6.98% [T009] to 13.22% [T012], so it remains a strong alternative. Usability also has more complaints, 62 [A001], but mean severity is 2.500000 [A003]. Access is severe among reported issues (mean severity 3.888889 [A038]), but has 9 complaints [A036]. Playback combines substantial severity with a rising trend.

## Limitations
Evidence covers public, self-selected reviews, not a customer population. Complaint and cancellation records only inform the ranking. Cancellation is expressed intent, not observed churn. Trend windows exclude the partial first and last months; issue classifications may leave some reports unresolved.
